name: Crossbowman
blurb: The Crossbowman is a ranged damage class in Wartales, added as a free update alongside The Skelmar Invasion DLC. Crossbowmen deliver powerful single shots and can deploy mechanical devices on the battlefield.

opts.name: Valorous Audacity
opts.desc: Every time this unit ends their turn next to an enemy and is not engaged in combat, you gain 1 VP.

opts.desc: Every time this unit kills an enemy, you gain 1 VP.

opts.name: Valorous Support
opts.desc: Every time this unit ends their turn next to an ally and is not engaged in combat, you gain 1 VP.

opts.up: Deals 50-90% dexterity damage to the target and randomly applies Burning, Bleeding or 2 Poisons. Consecutive Shot: Immediately triggers the effects of Poison, Burning or Bleeding.

opts.desc: Deals 40-80% dexterity damage to the target. If they are engaged with an ally, the ally executes an attack of opportunity.
opts.up: Deals 40-80% dexterity damage to the target. If they are engaged with an ally, the ally executes an attack of opportunity. Consecutive Shot: The ally's attack of opportunity is a guaranteed critical hit.

opts.name: Machinist

opts.desc: Each round, the first time this unit applies a Penalty to an enemy, they Reload.

opts.desc: Each round, if this unit used its basic shot 3 time(s), they Reload.
opts.up: Each round, if this unit used its basic shot 3 time(s), they Reload and gain 2 Aim.

opts.desc: Each round, the first time this unit lands a critical hit, they Reload.
opts.up: Each round, the first time this unit lands a critical hit, they Reload and gain 2 Aim.

opts.desc: After this unit executes an attack of opportunity, they Reload, then immediately fires a basic shot at the same target.
opts.up: After this unit has executed an attack of opportunity, they Reload, immediately fires a basic shot at the same target, then Reload again.

opts.name: Reinforced Grip
opts.desc: The first time this unit takes damage each turn, they Reload, then deal 20% of the damage taken to the enemy and knock them back 2 metres.
opts.up: The first time this unit takes damage each turn, they Reload, then deal 40% of the damage taken to the enemy and knock them back 2 metres.

opts.name: Masterful Movement

opts.up: Every 3 Reload, the next basic shot fired does not consume Loaded.

opts.name: Reactive Grip
opts.desc: At the end of their turn, this unit targets an area 3 metres around them. Performs an attack of opportunity against the first enemy entering the area, then Reloads.
opts.up: At the end of their turn, this unit targets an area 6 metres around them. Performs an attack of opportunity against the first enemy entering the area, then Reloads.

opts.name: Tracker's Patience
opts.desc: If this unit ends their turn with Loaded, they gain Ready.
opts.up: If this unit ends their turn with Loaded, they gain Ready and Deftness.

opts.desc: As long as there are no allied units within 5 meters, this unit gains the Lone Wolf status.

opts.up: Deals 50-90% dexterity damage to the target. The closer the target, the more the damage increases (maximum +100%). The unit firing the shot is knocked back and damaged for 5% of their Health. Can only fire once per round, but Reload grants 8 Aim.

name: Ranger
blurb: The Ranger is a melee assassin class in Wartales, specializing in daggers and poison. Rangers excel at flanking enemies, applying debuffs, and dealing high single-target damage from advantageous positions.

opts.up: Deals 35-45% dexterity damage to the target. Ambush: Performs 2 additional attacks. Fatal Blow: This skill can be reused in this round.

opts.desc: Forces enemies engaged in the area to disengage. They incur an attack of opportunity from their opponent.
opts.up: Forces enemies engaged in the area to disengage. They incur an attack of opportunity from their opponent. Enemies that are not engaged in combat are knocked back by 2 metres.

opts.name: Poisoner
opts.desc: Applies 4 Poisons to all units in the area.
opts.up: Applies 4 Poisons to all units in the area. Applies Vulnerability to those who are already poisoned.

opts.desc: Inflicts 40-60% dexterity damage and applies Bleeding. If the target is already bleeding, the damage is doubled.
opts.up: Inflicts 40-60% dexterity damage and applies Bleeding. If the target is already bleeding, the damage is doubled. The Critical Damage of the attack are increased by 30%.

opts.desc: Every time this unit attacks from behind, they apply 2 Poisons.
opts.up: Every time this unit attacks from behind, they apply 3 Poisons.

opts.name: Instinctive Throw
opts.desc: After using a skill, deals 20% dexterity damage to the closest enemy within 4 metres.
opts.up: After using a skill, deals 20% dexterity damage to the closest enemy within 4 metres and resets the Movement.

opts.name: Deadly Contract
opts.desc: At the start of the fight, applies Fragility to the nearest enemy. The Debuff is transferred to the nearest enemy when they die.
opts.up: At the start of the fight, applies Fragility to the two nearest enemies. The Debuff is transferred to the nearest enemy when they die.

opts.name: Ordeal
opts.desc: Every time a unit attacks a bleeding or burning poisoned unit, the attack also applies 1 Fever.
opts.up: Every time a unit attacks a bleeding or burning poisoned unit, the attack also applies 2 Fever.

opts.name: Wound Infection
opts.desc: Each time an enemy within 6 metres loses Health, that enemy loses an additional 5% of their Health.
opts.up: Each time an enemy within 10 metres loses Health, that enemy loses an additional 5% of their Health.

opts.desc: Doubles Poison stacks on all units in the area.
opts.up: Doubles Poison stacks on all units in the area. Then leaves a pool of poison.

opts.name: Low Blow

opts.up: Applies Blackout to all enemies in the area.

opts.name: Cold Blooded
opts.desc: Damage of attacks from behind increased by 20%.
opts.up: Damage of attacks from behind increased by 35%.

name: Thaumaturge
blurb: The Thaumaturge is a support class in Wartales, added as a free update alongside The Curse of Rigel DLC. Thaumaturges wield censers and flasks, using incense and alchemical concoctions to heal allies, buff the warband, or debilitate enemies.

opts.name: Valorous Audacity
opts.desc: Every time this unit ends their turn next to an enemy and is not engaged in combat, you gain 1 VP.

opts.name: Valiant Wait
opts.desc: Every time this unit ends their turn without using a skill, you gain 1 VP.

opts.name: Valorous Support
opts.desc: Every time this unit ends their turn next to an ally and is not engaged in combat, you gain 1 VP.

opts.desc: All allies in the area execute an Attack of Opportunity. You gain 1 VP for each enemy killed this way. 1 Inhalation: Guaranteed Critical Hit for all units in the area. 2 Inhalationss: Triggers a second Attack of Opportunity, then the targets gain 2 Rage.
opts.up: All allies in the area execute an Attack of Opportunity. You gain VP2 for each enemy killed this way. 1 Inhalation: Guaranteed Critical Hit for all units in the area. 2 Inhalationss: Triggers a second Attack of Opportunity, then the targets gain 4 Rage.

opts.name: Healer
opts.desc: Heals an ally for 30% of their maximum Health and removes their debuffs. 1 Inhalation: Bounces to the ally closest to the target within 3 metres. 2 Inhalations: The target gains Deflection.
opts.up: Heals an ally for 50% of their maximum Health and removes their debuffs. 1 Inhalation: Bounces to the ally closest to the target within 5 metres. 2 Inhalations: The target gains Deflection.

opts.name: Mixologist
opts.desc: Applies 2 Poison, 2 Corrosion, Bleeding and Burning to the target. 1 Inhalation: If this skill has already applied a status to the target, triggers that status's damage. 2 Inhalations: Applies an additional 2 Poison and 2 Corrosion.
opts.up: Applies 2 Poison, 2 Corrosion, Bleeding and Burning to the target and units within 4 metres. 1 Inhalation: If this skill has already applied a status to the target, triggers that status's damage. 2 Inhalations: Applies an additional 2 Poison and 2 Corrosion.

opts.desc: Applies 1 Frenzied Power to the target. 1 Inhalation: Applies Rally to the target. 2 Inhalations: The target becomes a 3 metre-radius area.
opts.up: Applies 2 Frenzied Power to the target. 1 Inhalation: Applies Rally to the target. 2 Inhalations: The target becomes a 3.5 metre-radius area.

opts.name: Passive Fumigation
opts.desc: Every time this unit inhales, applies the Censer's Inhalation effects to adjacent allies.
opts.up: Every time this unit inhales, applies the Censer's Inhalation effects to allies within 3 metres.

opts.desc: Every time this unit inhales, they apply 2 Protective Smoke to themselves and adjacent allies.
opts.up: Every time this unit inhales, they apply 2 Protective Smoke to themselves and allies within 3 metres.

opts.name: Overblown
opts.desc: As long as this unit has 2 or more Inhalations, enemies cannot engage them.
opts.up: As long as this unit has 2 or more Inhalations, enemies cannot engage them. When the unit finishes their turn, enemies within 3 metres gain Irritant Smoke for 2 turns.

opts.name: Bewitching Inhalation
opts.desc: When this unit inhales for the first time in a turn, triggers Inhalation's effect 1 more time.
opts.up: When this unit inhales for the first time in a turn, triggers Inhalation's effect 2 more times.

opts.up: When this unit purges, they apply 2 Doping Smoke to themselves and allies within 3 metres.

opts.up: This unit can purge multiple times per turn. The Purge skill now costs VP2 and is no longer considered a base action.

opts.desc: When this unit purges while adjacent to an ally and an enemy, triggers Purge's effect 2 time(s).
opts.up: When this unit purges while adjacent to a unit, triggers Purge's effect 2 time(s).
